name: carapace
description: Self-contained plugin bundling carapace orchestration, execution-plan-integrity, app-slop-audit, and six carapace-* subagents. Claude Code adds the live AbovePrompt progress bar, Agents side panel, and next-step suggestions; Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode get the functional skills, agents, and (for OpenCode) the /carapace command.

autoOpen.title: Open the Agents panel by itself
autoOpen.description: carapace (when a carapace worker starts or a plan is reported) or any (when any subagent starts)
